summary: Analyst, Global Asset Liability Management candidate with ~7 years across institutional ALM, interest-rate risk, and balance-sheet analytics at Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder with dual MSc credentials and delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement). Hands-on with duration-gap analytics, VaR/CVaR, fixed-income and derivatives sensitivity, IFRS 17/IFRS 9 transformation, and liability-driven investment strategies for pensions and insurers.

roles.title: Asst. Director — Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk)

sections.heading: ALM Risk Metrics & Senior Management Reporting
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative book of work).

Analyze and explain movement in duration gap, earnings risk, and VaR-style sensitivities under parallel and non-parallel interest-rate shocks; prepare updated risk-position summaries and market-driven gain/loss commentary for senior stakeholders.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs (rates, FX, inflation) and cross-check sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

sections.heading: ALM Systems, Process Improvement & Forecasting
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, improving forward-looking interest-rate and liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.

Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 to multi-year) supporting refinancing, funding, and asset-allocation decisions; embedded behavioural cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

sections.heading: Cross-Functional Engagement & Business-Driven Issues
bullets: Interface with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders on emerging analytical issues — including new-business impacts, restructuring, and segmentation changes — translating business requirements into modelling and reporting changes.

Operate within a formal model-governance framework: independently review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; document assumptions to auditability standards.

roles.title: Client Service Specialist — PFaroe ALM Platform

bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe ALM and portfolio analytics platform.
Advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations; validated model outputs post-deployment and migrated all assigned accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients; advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk teams on adoption of the standards.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes; coordinated milestone delivery across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions.

Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors; analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk under base and stressed regimes.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis, balancing return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity considerations; advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation via stress and sensitivity testing.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators; performed cash-flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for institutional clients.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR via Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and contribution-to-risk attribution.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (new jointly-sponsored plan) — on a team of three, developed and validated a model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluated duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies; presented findings to investment committees.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
